author: PinkPanter
text:
you are realy working hard here. no dubt if you keep going with this speed you will be master in no time...

my advice here is, that just ignore all unimportant stuff and just watch HTF zones and PA in HTF zones.. only this way you will sleep good, becouse for LTF trading you need emotional expirience...

please dont search for zones lower than Daily... ok.. you have to watch reaction in these zones on hourly or 30 min... but dont go straight trading LTF becouse you will lose will for trading...

start marking zones on HTF and watch how price reacts in there... so you can have then trades open for days...

but if you trade ltf you will do more mistakes becouse you are beginer.

this is my advice and my expirience, how i threw away 4 months learning and trading becouse i go straight in LTF trading
